subject: Emotions
title: Serendipity by Design
description: A 60-second lesson on Serendipity by Design.

hook.text: Penicillin was a surprise. Post-it Notes were a surprise. Velcro was a surprise. The best inventions start as accidents.

buildup.text: Serendipity means finding value in unexpected places. But it requires a prepared mind to notice the accident.

discovery.text: Pasteur said 'Chance favors the prepared mind.' Surprise is raw material; expertise shapes it into discovery.

twist.text: Companies like 3M and Google build slack time into work specifically to increase serendipitous surprises.

climax.text: MIT designed its Building 20 with confusing hallways so scientists from different fields would collide and talk.

punchline.text: Luck isn't random. It's surprise meeting preparation.

quiz.question: Who said 'Chance favors the prepared mind'?
